outcome: Seroprevalence of anti-Toxoplasma IgG antibodies in pregnant women
Vertical transmission of Toxoplasma gondii (measured by anti-Toxoplasma IgM antibodies in newborn cord blood)
cohort: The study included 251 women admitted for labour at a tertiary care hospital in Kolar, Karnataka, and their 251 newborns.
finding: Anti-Toxoplasma IgG antibodies were detected in 21.1% of the pregnant women, while none of the newborns showed confirmed evidence of vertical transmission of toxoplasmosis.
mod_finding: Maternal T. gondii seropositivity was not significantly associated with the mode of delivery.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from women admitted for labour between December 2014 and October 2016.
